in_sanskrit.name: यशु
in_sanskrit.meaning: यश: विद्यते तत् पुरुष: पुरुषव्यस्य: प्रसन्नत्वम्
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: He whose Yasha (glory, fame) exists in him and in others. A happy, contented man.

in_hindi.name: यशु
in_hindi.meaning: यश: वह जीवन का विधानी है
in_hindi.long_meaning: He who is the rule, the law of life, the one who possesses Yash (glory, fame)

in_tamil.name: யாஷு
in_tamil.meaning: யாஷ்: கருத்தல் அல்லது கலைவர், அவர்களில் மனம் மிக வேலையில்லை
in_tamil.long_meaning: He who is a teacher, a scholar, a guru, and whose mind is free from all worries

in_telugu.name: యశు
in_telugu.long_meaning: He who is the lord, the god, the king, the ruler, the prince, the emperor, the prosperous one

in_marathi.name: Yashu
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God, Jyoti, Light
in_marathi.long_meaning: Yashu हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Yashu is a name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Yash', which means 'God' or 'Jyoti', meaning 'Light'. This name is believed to bring good fortune, prosperity, and success in life.
